statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following holds. For a subset S of indices {0,...,n-1}, define total(S) = sum_{i in S} reward1[i] + sum_{i notin S} reward2[i]. Then (a) there exists S with |S| = k and total(S) = r, and (b) for every T subset of {0,...,n-1} with |T| = k, total(T) <= r.
preconditions: Let n = len(reward1). The preconditions are: len(reward1) = len(reward2) = n; 1 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= reward1[i] <= 1000 and 1 <= reward2[i] <= 1000; and 0 <= k <= n.
